title: Binder Introduces Angled M12 Connectors
summary: Binder launched angled M12 connectors for tubular sensors supporting centered PCB mounting and operating temperatures from -40°C to +85°C.

title: GE Vernova Modernizes São Simão Hydro Plant
summary: SPIC Brasil and GE Vernova completed the modernization of Generating Unit 3 at the São Simão Hydroelectric Power Plant.

summary: An 80-tonne protective lid has been installed over Albert Street station in Brisbane, Australia, to act as a flood barrier.

summary: Imec demonstrated the feasibility of patterning tight-pitch random logic structures down to a 22nm pitch using single-print High NA EUV lithography.

title: SBC Prices Surge Amid Memory Boom
summary: Single-board computers have become significantly more expensive, with older models and Raspberry Pi units selling at elevated prices.

summary: Mitsubishi Electric and SWISSto12 signed an MoU to develop small, lightweight satellite payloads using 3D-printing processes.

title: Comparative Analysis of Lattice-Based Scaffolds for Tissues
summary: Researchers evaluated how different lattice scaffold geometries affect structural, mechanical, and manufacturing performance in tissue engineering.

title: ImmunoGenAI for Optimizing Therapeutic Immune Evasion
summary: ImmunoGenAI uses multimodal deep learning to predict and optimize immune evasion and peptide-HLA binding in personalized therapeutic devices.

title: Solitary Wave Solutions in Two-Mode Nonlinear Equations
summary: Researchers investigated new solitary wave solutions and stability for the two-mode foam drainage equation modeling liquid flow in porous media.

summary: Researchers proposed an adaptive fusion interaction adversarial network to improve open-set cross-domain fault diagnosis using multimodal signals.

summary: A human-centered design framework proposes shifting prosthetic hands from transparent replacements to intelligent instruments focused on shared autonomy.

summary: A study maps recurrent supply chain governance gaps to decision points that influence embodied-carbon outcomes in building construction.

summary: A physical information-guided masked contrastive learning network was developed to improve defect detection accuracy in intelligent pipeline systems.

summary: A recent cyberattack highlighted that IT and OT systems manufacturing medical devices remain vulnerable to threats.

summary: The Center for the Advancement of Science in Space is celebrating 15 years of managing the International Space Station National Laboratory.

title: GBE-N Denies Record of SGE's Oldbury Site Interest
summary: Great British Energy – Nuclear stated it has no record of correspondence from SGE regarding an interest in acquiring the Oldbury site.

summary: Scientists note that establishing cities on the moon is constrained by a lack of sufficient water resources in polar craters.

summary: The companies are combining spatial data processing with open robotics platforms for commercial applications.
